notes.title: Halloween updates locked and loaded
notes.notes:
Hello! If you've seen a small patch update go by, this is just a modification to set the internal dates correctly for this year's Halloween event on Steam (which will run from Oct 28th to Nov 4th).

During that time, the Pumpkinhead character should spawn on Hunting activities, allowing you to claim the Pumpkin Pie achievement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40178701/229efb3be8e5af69754cba3174709868ea215ea0.png[/img]

But it won't be active until then this year so wait for it! (If you hunt and hunt and can't find a pumpkin *after* the 28th, let us know.) 

In unrelated news [b]Cute Bite is coming to consoles this Halloween[/b]! Got a friend who would enjoy an adorable vampire chomping on things? Look out for Cute Bite on Xbox, Switch, and PS4/5 web stores, it should be available on Oct 25th.

notes.title: Special Halloween Event + Bonus Art
notes.notes:

notes.title: Hunt the Pumpkinhead!
notes.notes:
From October 25th to November 1st, hunting for victims in town has a chance of spawning a special Pumpkinhead monster encounter. Finding and defeating this special monster will earn you the Easy as Pumpkin Pie achievement:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40178701/229efb3be8e5af69754cba3174709868ea215ea0.png[/img]

Happy hunting, and Happy Halloween!

notes.title: Unimportant Update
notes.notes: Just posting this in case anyone noticed the game downloading an update - it is solely adjusting the date range for the triggers for this year's Halloween event next month. Nothing else was changed.

notes.title: 1.6 Patch Update - Collector Achievement
notes.notes:
Due to a minor bug, previously the Collector achievement for completing the ending gallery was failing to unlock when you achieved your final ending and would only unlock the next time you finished the game after that. This should now be corrected.

If you have previously completed the gallery but not received the achievement, you will still need to reach an ending again in order to trigger the check and get the achievement. Any ending will do, even a bad one.

Please let us know if you have any problems or if the achievement still fails to fire.

notes.title: Happy Holidays
notes.notes:
To foster holiday spirit, we've commissioned some artwork featuring the Little Mistress decorating a Midwinter tree with straw ornaments:

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40178701/bc5ae7de9b8c2b778cecac0b7eaa2d390999a271.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40178701/a7da1189711c3389295c927735c927d58790e718.jpg[/img][/url]

(Art by [url=https://www.deviantart.com/crownxdoll/art/comm-Corrinna-and-Buttercup-900119806]crownxdoll[/url]) 

The other girl is Corrinna Lee, a character from the wizarding-school game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/15611/Magical_Diary_Collection/]Magical Diary[/url]. Her coloring is slightly reminiscent of our little vampire's, don't you think? Coincidence? Well, maybe not... but you'd have to play her storyline to find out!

Hope you all have a good holiday season and best wishes for the new year to come!

notes.title: Vote in the Steam Game Awards
notes.notes:
Since Cute Bite is new this year, it's eligible for most of the Steam Awards, if anything catches your fancy.

Innovative gameplay? Unusual storyline? Or a moment of zen when you just want to sit back and bite people?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40178701/2ca00739e3e4fd90363051ae7d2f8af899885296.png[/img]

In the meantime, Cute Bite and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/franchise/hanakogames]all our other products[/url] are currently on discount for the Autumn Sale:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40178701/1ea9e2ea799331fa4096574a4720704d6eef9d24.jpg[/img]

So if there are other games you've been waiting to pick up or recommend to a friend, now is a good time to glance over the list!

notes.title: Steam Trading Cards now active!
notes.notes:
Our card set has been approved, so you should be seeing teacher-themed cards in your inventory based on your previous playtime. Or if you're new, they'll unlock as you go. 

And of course no card set is complete without a cute badge:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40178701/815788e95f4ce14633a8f28c1a3ed723fb02e7ea.png[/img]

notes.title: Pumpkin Patch
notes.notes:
Small update to fix a bug in the code that calculates pumpkin creation.

If you have a save made during the Halloween event, you [i]might[/i] still be able to get a pumpkin to show up while hunting, but it's unlikely. For the most part you'll need to wait until next year (or cheat).

notes.title: Halloween Update + Special Achievement!
notes.notes:
Happy Spooktober!

From now until Nov 1st, hunting in town now has a chance to trigger a special encounter with a Halloween-themed target. Defeating this target will earn you the new Pumpkin Pie achievement. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40178701/229efb3be8e5af69754cba3174709868ea215ea0.png[/img]

(This also means the town has more hunting targets available than usual, especially during the late game, so get stalking!)

For seasoned players, we've also unlocked Developer Mode, for those who are interested in playing with cheat codes to adjust your stats (especially useful for tracking down extra ending variations you might not have seen yet) Chat with others in the forums to figure out new tricks!

notes.title: 1.3 patch update
notes.notes:
New version is available on the default branch.

FIXED:
  Fixed some situations where two scenes could be called in a single class
  Prevent Harem achievement on special endings where the romances don't complete
  Fix Divination reporting for Computer/Gardener romances when blocked
  Corrected the check about whether the vampire has ever baked bread or not 

CHANGED:
  If the Gardener romance is blocked, the Estate scene about gardens will no longer happen
  Rebellion modifier added to batgirl test at midwinter
  'Hide Flash' setting now hides the red flash in the ending as well

ADDED:
  New variant added to Adventurer ending
  New variant added to Education ending

notes.title: 1.2 patch update
notes.notes:
New version is available on the default branch.

FIXED:
   Fixed a display error in some of the high rebellion graphics
   Adjusted a calculation that could prevent the Harem achievement from popping under rare circumstances
   Adjusted class stress failure display to add the gold crown icon for lost money

CHANGES:
   Disabled the Quick Menu during hunting (you can still save manually if you want to)
   View/Hide stats button disappears on main schedule screen (when stats are always visible)
   Removing the cross from the Nurse sprite

ADDED:
   Divination now warns of a shadow when high rebellion would block an ending
   Three new variants for the Hacker ending
   A few late respondents added to the credits


Please let me know if you run into any problems!

notes.title: Minor patch update!
notes.notes:
New version is available on the default branch.

Achievement added: Jack of All Trades, which is achieved by unlocking ALL the jobs on a single run

Bug fixed: Quick saves and auto saves often had incorrect name data on them. This should now be improved.

Bug fixed: The Computer and Gardener romances were incorrectly triggering in some circumstances when they were meant to be blocked. This should now be fixed.

Please let me know if you encounter any problems!

notes.title: Release!
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce that Cute Bite is now available on Steam!

Enjoy raising your little vampires, and please let us know if you need any assistance!

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
At this point, all art planned for the initial release has been completed. There's always the chance of more being added if something strikes our fancy, but the basic roadmap is 100%. There are no barriers to release on this end.

All career endings have been added to the game and are currently in beta-testing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40178701/35e391400df9ed344ad21917c3ef5473eeb3d31c.png[/img]

Currently working on writing and adding all the optional character plotlines, romances, and ending variations. Some of these scenes can be quite hard to find. You never know when you might stumble over a secret!

No specific launch date at the moment but things are still on target for a fall release.

notes.title: Cute Bite demo available for a limited time!
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce that Cute Bite will be participating in this summer's Steam Next Fest, a preview event for upcoming games!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40178701/a7976d0949e3e2a27d247189463534da4d3c2dca.jpg[/img]

Sample an early preview of this vampire raising sim by playing through the first few months of the training year. Meet the vampire and her butler, take classes, raise money, and try to control the vampire's appetite...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40178701/2ca00739e3e4fd90363051ae7d2f8af899885296.png[/img]

This preview covers the first 80 days of gameplay, after which it will stop. It [i]may[/i] be possible to continue savegames into the full version, but this can't be completely guaranteed. The game is still in active development and many things are being changed and added.

This special preview version will only be available during June 2021, so check it out now!

notes.title: Live on Kickstarter (Funded in
notes.notes:
Cute Bite is [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hanako/cute-bite-a-vampire-raising-sim-rpg?ref=217t00]live on Kickstarter[/url] until April 30th, 2021!

The base goal was reached in less than an hour, and additional goals are now available which, if reached, will add extra character-based endings to the game and more chibi graphics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40178701/2218809985846ebf39b4c3bec9bd31b3e1b4ffa9.gif[/img]

As of this writing, a few of the limited high-tier options are still available, including the rights to name one of the characters who has a romance ending.

notes.title: Cute Bite is an upcoming vampire raising sim from Hanako Games
notes.notes:
